name: Fracture Processes in Rocks
description: Crack size effect in rocks, elastic rock rheology and structural discontinuities, atomistic estimate of rock strength, modes of rock fracturing, linear elastic fracture processes, elasto-plastic fracture processes, crack closure, cracks and anti-cracks, brittle and ductile fracture in rocks, natural fracture systems and patterns, rock fault mechanics and stress states, fatigue crack growth in rocks, Paris law and time-dependence fracturing in rocks, cracks and anti-cracks in rocks, sub-critical crack growth in rocks, fracture toughness testing rocks, design of subsurface systems through fracture mechanics, case studies. Synthetic models for rock masses fracturing. Reverse size effect.
